The records are structured as a repeating sequence of four distinct words, where each record consists of this four-word phrase repeated three times followed by the first word of the phrase again. The specific four-word phrase used in each record cycles through a fixed set of patterns based on the record number modulo 12. Each record concludes with its corresponding index number to uniquely identify it within the dataset.
